{"reason":"Broaden the demand branch so market-signal-mismatch qualifies directly and forecast-bias uses a 0.05 cutoff. This addresses the listed v1=unknown failures, including mismatch-only claims and biases of 0.065–0.081, likely improving accuracy above 0.708 and recovery-rate above 0.607 while preserving supplier-delay precedence.","source":"(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
         (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05)))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
